title: HoldEM Poker
author: RazXD
selftext:
Hey everyone! This is my first finished game project using Claude Sonnet 5.5, and I'd love to hear your thoughts on it!

I've been struggling a bit to get people to discover my game, so I'm hoping to get some feedback from the community and hopefully reach a few players along the way.

So far, I've tried:

* Instagram and X ads
* Publishing on [itch.io](http://itch.io)
* Working on SEO, but after 4 days, I've only gotten around 90 impressions and 4 clicks (3 of them were mine, and 1 was from a stranger XD).

I've heard that SEO takes time to build up, but so far, my page is buried around the 5th or 6th page of Google results, even when I search for the full URL.

I'd really appreciate it if you could give the game a try and let me know what you think! And if any of you have experience promoting web games or getting traffic to them, I'd love to hear your advice.

**Playable Link:** [**Holdem-online.com**](http://Holdem-online.com)  
  


Thanks for your time, and I hope you enjoy it!
